method: Rendered every ask page of both booklets with music_pages.py render at 130 dpi and read each full page; then zoomed clips with PyMuPDF (250-800 dpi) on every glyph in doubt: curly apostrophes (I’m, doesn’t, Barry’s, Carolan’s, look’d) and the opening quote in ‘twas, en dash vs hyphen (lines 1–2, bars 1–6, bars 1–4, 16–bar in HL composing Q1 vs 16-bar in Q3, eight-bar), the em dashes in OL Q4 (IV—ii—V), the superscripts in AA¹BB¹, the flat sign in B♭, the acute accents in An Bonnán Buí, full stops after excerpt headings, the case of every title and of "PREPARATORY WORK" (full capitals, not small caps), and every bullet at the left margin. Typed the printed text of every in-scope field from the renders into a script (bullets as "\n• " in questionContext, " • " between printed bullet lines in composing questionText, space for unbulleted lines) and compared it with the file string exactly, after collapsing runs of spaces; checked the code point of every non-ASCII character in the file strings. Tick-box glyph shape ignored; " • " / "\n• " treated as structure. Elective asks and composing grid stems were outside the brief and are not recorded.
